title: Combinatorial Effects of 5-Fluorouracil and Menadione on Wnt/beta-Catenin Pathway in Human Colorectal Cancer Cells.
authors: Warrier, Vidya P; Venkatachalam, Sankaran; Sakthivel, Ramasamy; Gromiha, M Michael; Karunagaran, Devarajan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究5-氟尿嘧啶和甲萘醌组合通过分子对接干扰β-catenin-TCF蛋白互作抑制结直肠癌Wnt信号，虽涉及蛋白-DNA相关转录因子复合物，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，方法仅含简单对接，与课题部分相关。
abstract: The incidence and mortality rates of colorectal cancer (CRC) are alarmingly high, and the scientific community is consistently engaged in developing newer therapeutic options for cancer cure or prevention. The fluoropyrimidine drug, 5-fluorouracil (5FU), remains the first line of treatment against CRC; nevertheless, relapses frequently occur since the cells gain resistance over time through various mechanisms. Studies have highlighted the significance of combinatorial treatment of a Wnt signaling inhibitor and 5FU as a better treatment strategy to overcome 5FU resistance. Small molecules that specifically target and disrupt beta-catenin-TCF interaction, a crucial step of the Wnt signaling, are promising in CRC treatment. In this study, we investigated the synergistic cytotoxic activity of menadione with 5FU as the former has previously been shown to downregulate Wnt signaling in CRC cells. Docking and experimental results suggest that the drug combination interfered with key protein-protein interactions in the beta-catenin-TCF complex, exerted synergistic anti-cancerous effects in CRC cells, and downregulated the expression of Wnt signaling proteins. Taken together, our data suggest that the simultaneous binding of 5FU and menadione to beta-catenin can block Wnt signaling by disrupting beta-catenin-TCF interaction and inhibit the proliferation of CRC cells.
abstract_zh: 结直肠癌（CRC）的发病率和死亡率高得惊人，科学界持续致力于开发新的治疗选择，以期治愈或预防癌症。氟嘧啶类药物5-氟尿嘧啶（5FU）仍是治疗CRC的一线方案；然而，由于细胞通过多种机制随时间获得耐药性，复发频繁发生。研究强调了Wnt信号抑制剂与5FU联合治疗作为克服5FU耐药性的更优策略的重要性。特异性靶向并破坏β-catenin-TCF相互作用（Wnt信号传导的关键步骤）的小分子在CRC治疗中前景广阔。在本研究中，我们探讨了甲萘醌与5FU的协同细胞毒性活性，因为先前已显示甲萘醌可下调CRC细胞中的Wnt信号。对接和实验结果表明，该药物组合干扰了β-catenin-TCF复合物中的关键蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用，在CRC细胞中发挥协同抗癌效应，并下调Wnt信号蛋白的表达。综合来看，我们的数据表明，5FU和甲萘醌同时结合β-catenin可通过破坏β-catenin-TCF相互作用来阻断Wnt信号，并抑制CRC细胞的增殖。
